_comment: Bambot — Pterodactyl egg. Import via Admin > Nests > Import Egg. Runs the Discord bot and the dashboard in one process on the server's primary allocation.
name: Bambot
author: rezzy550@gmail.com
description: Bambot — Discord community bot and web dashboard for the Bambu Lab community. Runs the gateway client and the dashboard API in a single Node process, serving the dashboard on the server's primary port.
startup: if [ "${AUTO_MIGRATE}" = "1" ]; then echo "[bambot] syncing database schema..."; npx --yes prisma db push --skip-generate || echo "[bambot] db push failed - check DATABASE_URL"; fi; node /home/container/start.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Bambot installer
#
# Clones the repository, installs dependencies, generates the Prisma client and
# builds all four packages. The build needs roughly 2 GB of memory because of
# the dashboard bundle; if the server has less, build locally instead and upload
# the repo with the dist/ folders already in place (see docs/PTERODACTYL.md).

set -e

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates openssl

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
  echo "[bambot] GIT_ADDRESS is empty. Upload the project to /home/container yourself, then reinstall with it set."
  exit 0
fi

# Normalise the repository URL and support private repos via a token.
if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS}.git"; fi
if [ -n "${GIT_USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${GIT_TOKEN}" ]; then
  GIT_ADDRESS="https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
  echo "[bambot] directory not empty, pulling instead of cloning"
  if [ -d .git ]; then git pull || true; fi
else
  echo "[bambot] cloning ${BRANCH:-main}"
  git clone --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH:-main}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
fi

echo "[bambot] installing dependencies"
npm install --no-audit --no-fund --ignore-scripts

echo "[bambot] generating the prisma client"
npx --yes prisma generate

echo "[bambot] building"
npm run build

# Keep ownership sane for the container user.
chmod -R 755 /mnt/server || true

echo "[bambot] install complete"
echo "[bambot] next: fill in DATABASE_URL and the Discord variables on the"
echo "[bambot]       Startup tab, then press Start. With AUTO_MIGRATE and"
echo "[bambot]       AUTO_DEPLOY_COMMANDS at 1, the schema and the slash"
echo "[bambot]       commands are set up for you on first boot."

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: HTTPS URL of the Bambot repository to deploy. Leave empty to upload the files yourself.

variables.name: Branch
variables.description: Branch to deploy.

variables.name: Git username
variables.description: Only needed for a private repository.

variables.name: Git token
variables.description: Personal access token, only needed for a private repository.

variables.name: Discord bot token
variables.description: Developer Portal > your app > Bot > Reset Token.

variables.name: Discord client ID
variables.description: Developer Portal > your app > General Information > Application ID.

variables.name: Discord client secret
variables.description: Developer Portal > your app > OAuth2 > Client Secret. Required for dashboard sign-in.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string, e.g. postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/bambot?schema=public

variables.name: Session secret
variables.description: Long random string for signing dashboard sessions. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 48

variables.name: Internal API key
variables.description: Shared secret between the bot and the API halves. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: The URL people open the dashboard on, with no trailing slash. Must match what Discord redirects to.

variables.name: OAuth redirect URI
variables.description: Must be registered in the Discord Developer Portal character-for-character. Normally PUBLIC_URL + /api/auth/callback

variables.name: CORS origins
variables.description: Comma separated. Normally identical to PUBLIC_URL.

variables.name: Bot owner IDs
variables.description: Comma separated Discord user IDs with full access to every server on the dashboard.

variables.name: Dev guild ID
variables.description: Optional. Registers slash commands instantly in this one server instead of waiting up to an hour for global propagation.

variables.name: Register commands on boot
variables.description: 1 registers all slash commands with Discord every time the bot starts. The panel gives you no shell, so leave this at 1 unless you deploy commands another way.

variables.name: Auto-migrate on boot
variables.description: 1 syncs the database schema on every start. Safe and useful; set to 0 once the schema is stable.

variables.name: Trust proxy hops
variables.description: 0 when the panel port is reached directly, 1 when behind nginx, Caddy or Cloudflare.

variables.name: Bind address
variables.description: Leave as 0.0.0.0 or the panel cannot route traffic to the server.

variables.name: Bot internal port
variables.description: Loopback-only port the two halves talk over inside the container. No allocation needed.

variables.name: Node environment
variables.description: Leave as production.

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: trace, debug, info, warn, error or fatal.
